summary: Underneath it, deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need. Owned, you read people and care on instinct and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
body: Underneath it, deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need. Owned, you read people and care on instinct and you reach, grow, and lift the room. Warmth and generosity that draw people in; watch the tendency to overextend. Comfort may be complicated by excess or expectation. Care can feel abundant at times, then difficult to measure or trust at others.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need — or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let emotional needs and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Warmth and generosity that draw people in; watch the tendency to overextend.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you read people and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
